children.value: > Fact From Story Obviously, this is not how Bankman-Fried reacted to the software bug that overestimated the amount Alameda owed to FTX by about $8 billion.
> > Fact From Story Instead, Bankman-Fried directed alleged co-conspirator Caroline Ellison to repay third-party loans and went on making investments.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Directing someone to repay loans and make investments is not a typical reaction to discovering a multi-billion dollar accounting error.
> Commonsense Knowledge Usually, if a hedge fund is missing billions of dollars, the owner would react with shouting and immediately contact law enforcement.
